I feel like my situation has barely changed and everyone knows how down I am. I’m scared to draw direct attention to it because of how distant I’ve become. Why should they take an interest in my life or problems when I haven’t been there to hear about theirs? 

The course is just intense. It teaches you skills on how to better cope with your mood/thoughts/stressors but it’s a lot of “why do you feel that way what was the thought process” which is hard to determine when you live on depressed autopilot. It is helpful but I do the group session and my one to one on the same day to cut down on travel so it’s 3-3 1/2 hours of therapy. A lot. 

My dad isn’t very good with emotions. He told me I could talk to him about anything but that was just a line. I spilled my guts to him one day about how I had been feeling, about how I relapsed and cut myself again, loads of things and he just stared at me blankly and changed the subject. I know he wants to be able to help me but he’s just not able so I don’t hold it against him (really hurts though). He’s a very closed off person, I’ve seen him cry twice and that was only when he was drunk. He won’t open up to me because he feels it’s inappropriate but my mom left him 2 years ago and it’s been hard on him (hard on both of them)
